newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks flat, seen recovering.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks flat, seen recovering.

text.p: Croatian stocks were mostly flat on Wednesday, but turnover doubled and traders said slow recovery was in sight.
"Market recovery will be more evident in the increased number of transactions than in growing prices," Igor Kos of Taurus brokerage told Reuters.
He said capital will be returning at a slower pace which should guarantee stability of blue chips and possible mild growth of other issues.
Of six traded issues four were flat and two down.
Turnover doubled to 5,5 million kuna and volume increased threefold to 6,552 shares.
Fully listed Zagrebacka Banka, flat at 980 kuna with 3,840 shares sold, was the most active issue.
Food processor Podravka which lost five kuna to 215, on volume of 1,781 shares was the biggest loser.
Confectioner Kras which stuck out as the sole gainer this week stayed unchanged at 420 kuna, trading 400 shares.
